title: A trophic model of the Lesser Antilles pelagic ecosystem
authors: Elizabeth Mohammed; Marcelo Vasconcellos; Steve Mackinson; Paul Fanning; Sherry Heileman; Fabio Carocci
loadability_evidence: No native EwE model file was verified or loaded; paper availability does not establish complete reconstruction.
documentation_evidence: Author-uploaded FAO Technical Document 2 reports input parameterization, diets, catches and 31 groups. CRFM report independently specifies constituent EEZs. No direct PDF endpoint was confirmed.
notes: Primary author-uploaded report; basin-scale pelagic model. Demersal/reef interactions include imports and must not be treated as a full EEZ ecosystem.
quality_rationale: Provisional screening score. A readable source is not evidence of a successfully reconstructed or load-tested Ecopath model. No native EwE model file was verified or loaded; paper availability does not establish complete reconstruction.
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
geometry_note: No defensible model polygon or coordinates extracted; do not substitute the EEZ boundary.
recommendation: Included within the broader Lesser Antilles pelagic domain; aggregated food web does not resolve this EEZ separately.
coverage_note: Included within the broader Lesser Antilles pelagic domain; aggregated food web does not resolve this EEZ separately.
